</script><script>
(async()=>{try{const text=document.getElementById('payload').textContent.trim(),bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(text),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const data=JSON.parse(await new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).text());const imports={};for(const [name,code] of Object.entries(data.modules))imports['kit/'+name]=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([code],{type:'text/javascript'}));window.OFFICE_DATA={layout:data.layout,models:data.models,objects:data.objects,media:data.media};const map=document.createElement('script');map.type='importmap';map.textContent=JSON.stringify({imports});document.head.appendChild(map);document.getElementById('loadingBar').style.width='65%';await import('kit/game.js');}catch(e){document.getElementById('loadStatus').textContent='خطا در اجرا: '+e.message;console.error(e);}})();</script>
</body></html>
